Lighter Co. perform at The Current Presents: Minnesota Music Month
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

The Current hosted Minnesota Music Month back in April, 2025 at Amsterdam Bar & Hall featuring Gully Boys, Bad Bad Hats, Kiss the Tiger, and Lighter Co. 

Watch Lighter Co.'s full performance above. 

Songs Performed
00:00:00 Danny
00:01:55 For Her
00:05:39 Take Another Lover
00:13:22 Six Feet
00:17:14 If You Kill All The Flowers

Musicians
Nolan: guitar, vocals
Colin: vocals, guitar
The Tank: keyboard
Drew: drums
Brett: bass
